methodology.caller_route: Post-claim async dispatch gets the first chance; transactional services/managed_host_tools fallback runs only on None. A fallback parser is not asserted to be invoked on every production request. MH3 explicitly names the actual managed_child_create caller and shared-definition requirement.
methodology.caveats: Regex can miss aliases/macros/index-only access and overcount literal/comment/test hits. Generated/vendor0 identified from exact selected paths and first15-line header markers; not a provenance claim about any outside tree. No tests, builds, installs, edits, live runtime state, model calls or reset-credit actions.
methodology.compatibility: Do not erase raw canonical request signatures, original argument identity before resolution, native history ordering/unknown fields, arbitrary tool/task/schema payloads, Python truthiness, Missing versus Null, integral-decimal acceptance or read diagnostics. Ordinary optional capability ports and optional input are real absence; correlated receipt fields are specific enum candidates.
external_support_sources: Existing runtime-schema/runtime-store/provider/process owners referenced by the cited production imports and prior task35 source traces.
methodology.hashes: List SHA256 is UTF-8 full repo paths in ASCII/byte sort order, each ending LF including final entry. Relative paths in file table are prefixed by scope. Individual source-content SHA256 also attached.
methodology.inspection: 16/16 production-containing files have focused function-body traces. 33 family rows describe focused excerpts; SV13 explicitly records the unresolved whole-object closure proof. This does not claim every line, test body, helper branch or historical provider version was manually read. All734 declaration marker lines are attached so mechanical versus focused coverage is visible.
methodology.inventory: git ls-tree -r --name-only 1b18e26491860b644f6e7373bc554e814cf95b66 -- workspaces/runtime/packages/runtime-services; intersect exact task35 exclusion list; git show pinned object for every file. Full contents read mechanically, bounded source-body excerpts and function/struct/enum/trait declarations inspected, native/tool tags and branches enumerated without top-N cap.
methodology.metrics: Whole physical files, including inline tests, comments and string literals. Files with tests interleaved still classified production-containing; four dedicated test-only modules separately classified. Line count is split('\n').length including trailing empty segment. These are discovery counts, not AST counts or runtime defects.
methodology.priorities: P1 concrete bounded refactor with owner+caller; P2 broader compatibility migration; P3 unresolved deeper proof. No priority is a confirmed bug severity. Every proposed witness is future work, not executed.
methodology.source_aliases: In AT rows transfer.rs=src/account_transfer.rs, driver.rs=src/account_transfer_driver.rs, executor.rs=src/account_transfer_executor.rs. In CC rows controls.rs=src/claude_controls.rs, service.rs/store.rs=src/claude_controls/service.rs and store.rs. Other short tools/services/runtime paths are relative src/provider_callbacks/; managed_host_tools.rs under src. Full inventory paths disambiguate.
methodology.types: Use existing Phase/Action/Ticket/ConnectionScope/RequestId/RequestCertainty/SessionOutcome, ClaudeControlCommand/PermissionMode, monitor Input, TaskCommand/WorkWrite, LifecycleRequest and authorization owners. Add consumed DTOs only with their named owner; cross-language TS bridge/native contracts need generated/shared consumers or parity, not duplicate hand-maintained definitions.
